US National Parks Face Staffing, Culture War Challenges

America's national parks are experiencing significant staffing shortages, leading to traffic jams and contributing to a "culture war" within the park system. Firefighters are also struggling with shortages of staff and equipment amidst a record wildfire season, with one report stating they are "running thin."
